cmd.edit.flip_hand.desc: Mirrors the selected doors and windows along the wall so the hinges move to the other end of the opening.
cmd.edit.flip_facing.desc: Swings the selected doors and windows to the other side of the wall.
opening_grips.flip_hand.tip: Hinges to the other end of the opening (Shift+F)
opening_grips.flip_facing.tip: Opening to the other side of the wall (Shift+G)
opening_grips.flip.none: Select a door or window to flip
